why: The arm nothing else reaches: no cap at all, so `recommended_action` falls through both loops and returns `proceed`. Without it the declared cards would cover only degraded runs and could not tell a regression that invents a cap from a healthy run. Its band is the other half of what it records: 91 is a STRONG number under no cap, and what holds it at WORKABLE is the answer-key floor - no outcome case supplies a row review - which the declaration below now says rather than leaving to a flag nobody named (#405).
